title: sebastiania hispida var. purpurella
intro: Sebastiania hispida var. purpurella, commonly known as the "Purple Sebastiania", is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family, characterized by its purple leaves and medicinal properties. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sebastiania hispida var. purpurella include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain, reducing inflammation, and lowering fever. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
